decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (297-030, 297-031, 297-032, 297-033, 297-034, 297-035, 297-036, received 24 January 2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The windows 3 x formed in the southern elevation (2 x in the flank wall and 1 x in the ground floor rear extension) shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension incorporating the remodelling of existing rear wing to form a bay and alteration to existing first floor window in rear wing with two new ground floor windows.
